name: Match detail pages resolve under es and pt locale prefixes
description: Every match page must exist at /en/match/<id>, /es/match/<id> and /pt/match/<id>. A real id is sampled from the live data so the test does not hard-code a match. A build that only routes the English match page fails the localized variants.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /api/matches and capture the id of the first match in the response
Navigate to /es/match/<captured-id> using the sampled id
Navigate to /pt/match/<captured-id> using the sampled id

Verify both /es/match/<id> and /pt/match/<id> return 200 and render a match detail page (team names, kickoff time block visible). If either localized match route 404s, redirects to the English path, or renders an empty shell, the test fails.
